evidenceClaims.claim: Causal diagrams can clarify which variables are confounders, mediators or colliders and can help identify adjustment sets; selecting covariates solely by statistical significance can create bias.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Conditioning on a collider can induce a noncausal association between variables that were otherwise independent, so “adjust for everything available” is not a generally valid causal strategy.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Target-trial emulation makes eligibility, treatment strategies, time zero, follow-up, outcome and causal contrast explicit and helps expose common observational-design biases.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Propensity scores balance measured baseline covariates when appropriately implemented; they do not randomize treatment and cannot by themselves remove unmeasured confounding.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: After propensity-score matching/weighting, covariate balance should be assessed directly; statistical significance tests of baseline differences are not the preferred balance diagnostic.
evidenceClaims.qualification: Standardized differences are commonly used; exact diagnostics depend on design.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Immortal time bias occurs when survival time during which the outcome could not have occurred is misclassified or incorrectly attributed to an exposure group.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: The E-value is a sensitivity metric for the strength of unmeasured confounding needed to explain away an observed association; it does not prove absence of unmeasured confounding or causal identification.
evidenceClaims.qualification: Use alongside substantive bias analysis, not as a causal certificate.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: STROBE is a reporting guideline for observational studies; adherence improves transparency but does not itself establish low risk of bias or causality.

problemCards.title_cn: 多因素回归把所有有P<0.1的变量都塞进去，就控制了混杂吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does p-value-based covariate selection control confounding?
problemCards.observation: 作者仅按单因素P值选择adjustment variables。
problemCards.why_it_matters: confounder身份取决于因果结构而非它在当前数据中的显著性；错误调整还可能引入collider/mediator bias。

problemCards.title_cn: “变量越多调整越严谨”这句话对吗？
problemCards.title_en: Is more covariate adjustment always better?
problemCards.observation: 模型把暴露之后的变量、共同后果和中介一并调整。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 过度调整或collider conditioning可产生偏倚。
problemCards.claim_boundary: adjustment set需要因果问题和时间顺序支持。

problemCards.title_cn: 把治疗后的biomarker加入主效应模型，会更“控制混杂”吗？
problemCards.title_en: Should a post-treatment mediator be adjusted as a confounder?
problemCards.observation: 治疗后的中间变量被当baseline confounder调整。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 若变量位于因果路径上，调整可能改变estimand并截断部分总效应。
problemCards.claim_boundary: 不能在没有明确estimand时把post-exposure变量统称confounder。

problemCards.title_cn: 做了PSM，两组baseline P>0.05，就说明平衡了吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does P>0.05 after PSM prove balance?
problemCards.observation: 匹配后用每个baseline变量的P值判断平衡。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 显著性检验受样本量影响，不是设计平衡的最佳诊断；应看standardized differences等。

problemCards.title_cn: PSM 后就等同随机试验了吗？
problemCards.observation: 匹配后文章写“消除了所有混杂”。
problemCards.why_it_matters: PS只能基于已测量、正确建模的baseline covariates改善可比性；未测混杂仍存在。
problemCards.claim_boundary: PSM支持measured-confounding adjustment，不是因果保证。

problemCards.title_cn: 匹配后再按普通独立样本t检验/Cox，完全没问题吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can matched samples be analyzed as fully independent?
problemCards.why_it_matters: matching会创建依赖结构/设计信息，后续估计与SE应与estimand和匹配设计匹配。

problemCards.title_cn: 把“最终接受治疗的人”从确诊日起算生存，会有什么偏倚？
problemCards.title_en: Why is classifying future treatment from diagnosis dangerous?
problemCards.observation: 患者必须存活到治疗日才能进入treated group，却从diagnosis开始计时。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 治疗前这段“必须存活”的时间若错误归给treated会制造保护性immortal time。

problemCards.title_cn: 观察性治疗比较为什么要先写“目标试验”方案？
problemCards.title_en: Why specify a target trial before observational causal analysis?
problemCards.observation: 研究直接从数据库筛“治疗/未治疗”后跑Cox，没有明确eligibility、time zero和assignment策略。
problemCards.why_it_matters: target trial框架能暴露time zero、eligibility、treatment strategy等设计错位。
recommended_reasoning: 先定义想模拟的随机试验，再映射到observational data。

problemCards.title_cn: E-value 很大，就证明结果是因果的吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does a large E-value prove causality?
problemCards.observation: 作者用E-value作为“排除未测混杂”的证据。
problemCards.why_it_matters: E-value量化一种敏感性门槛，不验证无未测混杂，也不处理selection/measurement/model bias。

problemCards.title_cn: 横断面数据发现A和B相关，能写A导致B吗？
problemCards.why_it_matters: 时间顺序和替代因果方向通常无法仅由横断面association识别。
problemCards.claim_boundary: 一般只能支持association，除非有额外设计识别。

problemCards.title_cn: 只分析“术后活过6个月”的患者研究治疗效果，会有问题吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can conditioning on post-treatment survival bias treatment comparisons?
problemCards.observation: 纳入标准依赖治疗后发生的生存/事件。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 对exposure影响的post-exposure selection条件化可能造成selection/collider bias。

problemCards.title_cn: 按 STROBE 写全了，就说明观察性研究低偏倚吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does STROBE compliance prove low risk of bias?
problemCards.observation: 文章checklist完整，作者据此称研究methodologically rigorous。
problemCards.why_it_matters: reporting transparency与internal validity是不同维度。

problemCards.title_en: Should a new 2026 RCT default to CONSORT 2010?
problemCards.observation: 新稿仍把2010 statement当当前版本。

problemCards.title_cn: RCT方案写作为什么要看 SPIRIT 2025？
problemCards.title_en: Why use SPIRIT 2025 for RCT protocols?
problemCards.observation: protocol缺少关键预设项目，后续容易发生分析自由度。

problemCards.title_cn: 只在明显癌症 vs 健康志愿者中算AUC，能代表临床诊断吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does case–healthy-control AUC represent clinical diagnostic accuracy?
problemCards.observation: 病例极典型、对照全健康，没有临床疑似人群。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 诊断accuracy受participant spectrum与selection影响；目标人群应匹配真实临床用途。

problemCards.title_cn: index test参与了reference diagnosis，还能独立评估accuracy吗？
problemCards.title_en: What if the index test contributes to the reference standard?
problemCards.observation: 被评估检测结果用于最终gold standard判定。

problemCards.title_cn: 动物实验严格按 ARRIVE 2.0 报告，就能说明结果可转化到人吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does ARRIVE compliance prove human translatability?
problemCards.why_it_matters: ARRIVE解决reporting透明度；species/model relevance与translation需要另行判断。

problemCards.title_cn: Reporting guideline 越多套越好吗？
problemCards.title_en: Should every study use every reporting guideline?
problemCards.observation: 文章同时机械套多个不匹配checklist。
problemCards.why_it_matters: guideline应与study design和reporting目的匹配；错误套用会制造形式合规而非科学清晰。
recommended_reasoning: 先正确分类study design，再使用当前匹配guideline。

problemCards.title_en: Does multivariable adjustment justify causal language?
problemCards.observation: 观察性回归调整若干covariates后使用cause/reduce/prevent语言。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 回归调整只是因果识别的一部分；未测混杂、selection、measurement、time-zero等仍需满足。
problemCards.claim_boundary: 调整后的association不自动升级为causal effect。
